formats_detail: [{"format": "STL", "full_name": "Stereolithography", "file_size": "706 KB", "file_count": 3, "version": null, "renderer": null}]
description_text:
Shark Fin and Tail - Creative Decoration - STL Printable
To be used as decorative item.You can paint it as your favorite shark (gray, black tip, etc).You can print a single one, or a few of them and create like a group of sharks.
The idea here is a simple creative decoration that interacts very well with your table or where you place it, making it looks like a water surface.
This size is pre-set as: Shark Fin: 93,5x50x33mmShark Tail: 31x21x13mmBut you can resize it as you prefer to create bigger or smaller sharks.
I also set two files inside, one separatedly (fin and tail) and one with both of them together, in case you can print two items.
I didn't test it in a 3D printer, so let me know if you have any trouble with it.
Feel free to share your printed model with me, it would be a pleasure to see the final result of your work :)And please, do not share my STL file for free in STL groups, I set it cheap so any1 can have access to it, and its how I pay my bills :)

In the exploration of 3D printing applications to help nature, here is the latest find.
The Bee Hotel

The utility of this model is the preservation of pollenisers, key players in biodiversity.
Solitary bees build their nests by themselves and lay their eggs in tunnels, such as dead wood or hard soil.
The Bee Hotel mimics these conditions.

Easy to make this model is designed to be printed without support.
Height 140 mm
Width 90 mm
depth 120 mm

Then, it remains only to fill the interior with hollow plant stems (bamboo, reed, etc ...)
Your house of bees must be placed in full sun, facing south-east or south.
You can suspend it (do not swing it too much, avoid the branches) or hang it on a screw (6 mm diameter).
A southern exposure is recommended.

description_text:
After the discovery of the Hex Crystals and the realization that the Miles had been exploited by alien races since long before they arrived, the Star Pharaohs were forced to devote more time to recovering their stolen Hex Crystals than mining the Miles as their programming demanded. The solution was to develop a dedicated group of mining drones, much as their creators the Makers had done with the Star Pharaohs themselves. The Skorp Swarms turned out to be so efficient and effective that they are even able to join the Star Pharaohs in battle between mining shifts. Don’t let their cute appearance fool you- their pincers are able to squeeze asteroids into nanodiamonds and the antimatter beams on their tails can cut through the most powerful alien foes like fabric. Unlike the Makers, the Star Pharaohs stick by their creations, and the Skorp Swarms serve as an invaluable ally to their creators. 
Skorp Swarms fit on a 40mm base (3 Skorps can fit on a base) and serve as a great proxy for fast attack units in 28mm scifi wargaming.

description_text:
This design is inspired by the meditative sight of an insect flying over a lake and repeatedly touching the surface of the water. On the lake forms a pattern of circles that flow into each other. They are connected by the fly's trajectory. 
This ring is design>comfort as it is relatively thick at 6mm. But of course you can get used to that. Then you have an absolutely unusual piece of jewelry.  
The circles are 1.4mm thick and between 11 and 5.7mm wide. They are connected by wire bridges, each 1/3 thick (3.6 - 1.9mm). At the widest point the ring is 16.5mm wide. Volume: 1332 cubic millimeters. You can scale the ring to fit your finger. Suitable for 3D printing (such as sls, sla, fdm) and wax casting.
As a trained goldsmith with years of experience in 3D design, I work with great care. If something does not fit, please feel free to contact me.
If my designs inspire you contact me for your personal ideas.

description_text:
Hello,
Here is my latest model V2 Sci Fi Bug  (one of more to come). I thought id try a mecha sci fi bug design and this is what I made over the last week. Built in zbrush with no concept as usual - original designs. I initially made the legs too thin so had to rebuild with sturdy thicker set design which actually made it look better imo. I made lots of sunken panel designs around the model and set planes at angles to look aerodynamic and also catch the light from different angles. The images are mostly renders and I have added 3 photos of the raw print. Raw being snipped off suppports but have yet to trim off some support tips. You can only just see them in the photos. I printed this on my elegoo mars 3 with water washable resin with default settings. Auto supports and some extras I added where needed. I tilted the nose end up about 15-20 degrees. Took about 2.5 hours on default. Hope you like it and thanks to all who buy my models. Looks great in chrome too!If you need any help just send a message and I will reply promptly.
The size is103.27mm X62.82mm Y120mm Z
(Please note * The photos of the print show the size flat on the build plate which was printed at the reduced size AT 75%)77.45mm X47.12mm Y90.00mm  Z
ThanksCalum

KAWS is an American graffiti artist and designer known for his toys, paintings, and prints. Pop Art and culture permeate his cartoonish Companion series of figurines, which bear a resemblance to the works of Takashi Murakami. KAWS is a multi-faceted artist straddling the worlds of art and design in his prolific body of work that ranges from paintings, murals, and large-scale sculptures to product design and toy-making. His iconic “XX” signature has its roots in the beginning of his career as a street artist in the 1990s, when he began altering found advertisements by incorporating his own masterful paintings. Evoking the sensibilities of Pop artists like Andy Warhol and Claes Oldenburg, KAWS possesses a sophisticated humor and thoughtful interplay with consumer products and collaborations with global brands. He often draws inspiration and appropriates from popular culture animations to form a unique artistic vocabulary and influential cast of hybrid cartoon and human characters.

Additional Notes:
This model was created for 5 hours form our Leading 3D artists to ensure you get the best quality model and save precious production time.
If you have any questions, you can contact us through support. Just send a support ticket!

description_text: The famous assasin from Dune, specifically Denis Villenuve's 2021 remake. The hunter seeker was a small motion based assasin that would hover through the air emmiting a high pitched noise until it detected motion at which point it would fly toward it piercing the target with a poisoned needle. I recreated this from scratch based off of various drawings as well as shots from the movie and descrptions from the frist book. The model is rigged and ready for use in animations, games, and almost anything else. It is fairly lowpoly with the heaviest part being the textures. The textures may or may not pack correctly, if they dont, basic image textures will suffice for the most part. I wasn't able to link the textures I used for legal reasons but packing them into the file was allowed.

description_text:
Discover our cutters, we have a wide variety, with several sizes to choose from. They can be worn on casual occasions or even for professional use.
All cutters are made with a sharp, tapered tip, easily cutting through soft materials. On the other hand, they have an edge to make them firmer and less flexible.
The cutters can be used to make cookies, jewelry, small decorations, candies, etc.
Printing Tips:

  - Do not use nozzles larger than 0.4. Sometimes it is necessary to use 0.05mm horizontal compensation.

  - Smaller dimensions, easier to print in resin. But they work perfectly in FDM.

Usage Tips:

  - We recommend that the thickness of the dough is around 5 mm (~ 1/5 inch). Especially in dough cutters with details that only appear if the dough is more than 2mm.

  - For prettier cookies, follow a yeast-free recipe.

  - If you use flour and chilled dough you can get better results.

  - If it is to make jewelry, 2.5cm or 3cm is usually used. If your goal is to make cookies you should choose between 5-8cm. With small cutting edges it is more difficult to make details.

description_text:
Tarantulas comprise a group of large and often hairy spiders of the family Theraphosidae. 
As of December 2023, 1,100 species have been identified, with 166 genera.
The term tarantula is usually used to describe members of the family Theraphosidae, although many other members of the same infraorder (Mygalomorphae) are commonly referred to as tarantulas or false tarantulas. Some of the more common species have become popular in the exotic pet trade. 
Many New World species kept as pets have setae known as urticating hairs that can cause irritation to the skin, and in extreme cases, cause damage to the eyes.
The Tarantula dimensions are the following (mm): 
Height- 30
Width- 190
Depth- 188
Sculpting software used: Blender
Render method used for the previews: Cycles
Filament: PLA
Slicer used to 3D print: Ultimaker Cura
Settings I've used to 3D print:
Standard quality - 0.2mm
Infill - 20%
Supports - No supports should be needed
Speed - 50% first 20 layers and 100% for the rest
Plate Adhesion - Skirt
Cooling - Enabled
Travel - Retraction Enabled

description_text:
Designed from scratch is an insect repellent light, as a single piece, high in detail, ideal for scale modeling (currently in 1/24 and 1/25 scale).
Perfect for those dioramas & vignets!
2 versions provided, with the front mech and without.
If printing with the mesh;The light must be angled slightly rearwards & sideways to allow the thin mesh to print with supports, or print as normal and allow the supports to damage the mesh to give a beaten up look. 
If printing without the mesh;Print as normal and add your own mesh (1:1 insect screen etc) in front.
The light has 3 round holes on 1 side and an internal locator on the other side, to paint your light elements separately and thread them through - sample pics provided in the MAKE tab of the listing.
At 1/24 scale (AS-IS), use 1.2mm round rod
Be sure to tag @mattys_custom_scale on Instagram with your finished prints & projects!
Intended for personal use, not to be redistributed without consent

description_text:
OverviewHigh-quality Beehive Entrance Platform with an adjustable gate designed for standard German beehives (DN/Zander/Dadant compatibility notes below). The landing board improves take-off/landing, while the height-adjustable entrance reducer lets you fine-tune ventilation, traffic flow, and pest protection across seasons.
Key Features
Adjustable entrance gate: set multiple opening heights for winter/summer and night protection.
German standard ready: dimensions planned around common DN/Zander/Dadant front widths (see sizing).
Outdoor-oriented design: filleted edges, drainage-friendly shapes, PETG/ASA recommended.
Print-friendly: no complex supports, 0.2 mm layer height friendly, robust walls for outdoor use.
Customizable: scale slightly to match your hive face; includes clear dimensional diagram.
Use Cases
Reduce robbing and control pests at the Flugloch (hive entrance).
Seasonal ventilation control and traffic management.
Easy landing for foragers; safer night-time reduction.
What’s Included
3mf  (watertight, manifold) + OBJ/FBX on request.
Dimension sheet (PNG/JPG) with key distances and suggested print settings.
Readme (PDF): assembly, mounting, maintenance.
Sizing & Compatibility
Designed to fit the front face of German hives (DN/Zander/Dadant); entrance width is adjustable via the gate.
Units: millimeters. Model at 1:1 scale.
Minor scaling (±2–3%) is acceptable to match brand-specific hive tolerances.
Print Recommendations
Material: PETG/ASA (outdoor/UV), ABS if protected; PLA not recommended for long-term outdoor use.
Layer height: 0.2 mm; Walls: 3–4 perimeters; Infill: 20–35%; Top/Bottom: 4–6 layers.
Orientation: gate rails horizontal; landing surface face-up; supports minimal/optional.
Hardware: stainless screws if you plan permanent mounting (not included).
License & Usage
Personal Use: unlimited prints for your own apiary.
Commercial Use (optional upgrade): limited production runs for small shops; contact for extended terms/branding.

Predator Dog STL file optimized for FDM-FFF DLP-SLA-SLS printinginspired by the film, THE PREDATOR, from 2018
3 versions File, for FDM, For SLA, for SLShowever, the dimensions can be changed with each slicer
in total is composed of 5.448 mil pointsall the files have been decimated by the polygons, but without losing the details, this makes the light files suitable for each computer

all files are already in place for optimal printing 
Predator Dog 3D model was designed to get a clean print result, without considering printing material consumption, However, you are free to rotate, or scale, every part of the model in the most convenient way for you.Each file has been checked and repaired with NetfabbThe parts of the model are already positioned for 3D printingCompatible with every Slicer- Simplify3D, Care, Slic3r, etc ...All the parts of the model have been cut so as to be printed vertically, for a higher quality of printing
Recommended settings for printing
each part was cut to be printed vertically, to have a better quality print, so for the upper parts, it is recommended to print with a 4-5 skirt
